description: #749 negative control for the test-file discount: traversal literals that appear only inside tests/test_*.py chunks (static fixture paths under test directories) do not classify path_handling_changes, but they stay visible as discounted diff_test_file signals in path_handling_provenance so the decision is explainable from the artifact alone. The production chunk with an env-provided output path stays clean (env/config paths are operator-owned, not attacker surfaces).

+output_path = os.environ.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT")
